", "attributes": {"header": 1}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": {"image": "https://storage.googleapis.com/indie-hackers.appspot.com/post-images/4q8N27PMPTYGDWwx0lmr/vOqaQ3DJwYRP8MNEjUOSMger71w1/james-rose-founder-of-content-snare.png"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "> 作者: James Rose", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "> 标签: B2B营销、SaaS、SEO、时间管理", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "你有没有为一个不在乎的人工作过？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "James有。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "而且他受够了。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他的职业生涯从控制系统工程师开始——fancy name for写代码自动化机器。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但厌倦了为不在乎的人工作。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他和合伙人只想out。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "想build something of their own。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "2010年，他们启动第一个生意——SEO niche的软件，2022年左右卖掉。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "从那里，他co-founded数字代理，专做网站和软件开发。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这暴露给他们很多问题，begging for软件解决方案。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "2014年，他们build产品把Stripe交易导进Xero（远早于Xero提供这功能）。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "2017年卖掉。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "然后，建了最新venture——Content Snare，现在100万美元ARR。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "做代理的时候，他们知道不想永远做client work，所以一直在找新产品idea。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "某个时刻，他读到一条建议：和潜在客户聊，不带任何idea——让他们说自己最大的问题。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他和15-20个代理公司老板坐下来，让他们聊网站设计流程从开始到结束。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "每个人都说从客户那拿content有多痛苦。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这些代理分享的emotional responses和stories有validation，但他们想要money on the table来确认。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他开了个Facebook群和newsletter for网页设计师，建initial audience。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "用几个UX设计pre-sold heavily discounted annual plan。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "只卖25个pre-sales，约100美元，很快卖光。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "够了，这就是confirmation。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "钱不多，只想要validation。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Content Snare开始是帮网页设计师streamline client content collection的工具，后来pivot到专业服务比如会计。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "现在服务1600+客户，年增约50%。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Build过程从basic UX designs开始，成本1-2千美元。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "代码花了约六个月，用in-house dev team和agency混合——虽然后者引入了technical debt，困扰了他们多年。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "用Ruby on Rails做后端，Angular 2做前端。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "不确定这是不是最好选择，但每个框架都有challenges。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "项目完全self-funded，靠之前产品和client work的收入支撑。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "而且还在run代理，所以时间得在client work和新产品之间split。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "处理这个，他一直喜欢daily theming—— dedicating whole day to something，比如一周3天client work、2天产品。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们也很ruthless，只建minimum viable方式解决问题的stuff。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "虽然有几处slipped，甚至今天他还在想为什么有些东西建得那么早。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "RICE或ICE这种prioritization frameworks是game changers，帮助stay focused on impactful work。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "用来prioritize feature development和marketing projects。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "输出是按重要性排序的projects或features列表，所以就从top开始往下做。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "知道该work on什么变得容易多了。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Automation也是massive advantage。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Zapier和Make这些工具saved countless hours，automating processes原本需要多hires。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "想了解更多，看他Indie Hackers上的post。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "有时候只一个change就能对growth产生huge difference，比如找到new industry to serve。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Content Snare最具挑战性的时期是卡在约30万美元ARR的prolonged plateau。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "看起来一切正常。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Churn不算坏，loads of amazing feedback，网站流量很稳——但 somehow，他们就是没增长。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "心理上挺rough的。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "看起来像doing everything right但结果underwhelming。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他开始做其他事，比如YouTube频道和Zapier课程，因为几乎对产品失去信心。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "突破来自找到new industry to serve。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "通过SEO，他们acquired small percentage of industries outside主要target网页设计，我猜答案就在那里面。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他和tons of customers、network里的business owners聊。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Spreadsheets评估了约30个industries，试图找出哪个最可能succeed。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Insane timing，一周内，两个会计告诉他们产品completely transformed their business。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "一周后，收到email有人interested in acquiring他们for会计行业。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "那时他们意识到必须是accounting。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Focus on that industry重新点燃growth，把他的excitement带回来。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Funny how easy it is to be motivated when you're growing。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "最艰难的挑战之一是学会effectively market和sell。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "像很多工程师，他initially anti-sales和anti-marketing，但总得有人learn to sell，他partner是epic engineer所以留在那side。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "早期增长最初靠content marketing和SEO，target specific use cases，辅以Facebook群、newsletter、podcast。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这些channels互相feed。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "比如blog posts promote Facebook群，有人join Facebook群可以enter email get newsletter。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Newsletter聊podcast和Facebook群。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这engine跑了很久。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Podcast另一个awesome方式—— helped build relationships with influential people。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这些人更可能talk to you当你offer把他们放在your audience面前，所以open doors，lead to partnerships、guest posts on incredible websites（强化SEO），等等。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Pivot到accounting后，策略变了。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "现在主要channels："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "和行业specific apps的integrations做partnerships", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Tradeshows", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "大量IRL events", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Networking", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "如果你meet enough right people，就开始在industry里get known。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这lead to unexpected opportunities。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "比如，现在有三家partner companies（adjacent软件或服务）trained他们的Customer Success teams用他们的产品，可以recommend给own customers。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "今年初，从Xero在17场events上stage shoutout。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这stem from他在event上meet的某人。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Still blows his mind that this happened。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "商业模式挺standard。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Classic free trial to self-serve monthly subscription。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "三个tiers，大客户custom pricing。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这space很多客户想talk to someone，所以做30-minute demos。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他做了很久，现在有人帮忙。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "增长slow but steady。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "当然没有magic bullet帮忙grow revenue，除了pivot to new industry。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他认为最重要的是spend a lot of time talking to customers。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "可以是demos、reach out to top customers for feedback，或和industry consultants聊。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "听到他们struggling with什么，所以help build genuinely helpful的东西。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "有趣的是，每月trials数量几年没变，但通过increasing conversion rate to paid accounts和decreasing churn grow了。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "网页设计师conversion to paid约15%，会计接近30%。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们也generally在higher plans。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这两件事make enormous difference。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "给创始人的建议："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Ruthless地validate ideas before building。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "不只依赖verbal validation——get commitments， ideally monetary ones。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "人们会说like your idea来be nice，然后你建了something that no one wants。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "同样apply to features。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "只建会solve problems的东西。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "MVP your features。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "建simplest version看人们怎么用（if at all）。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们overengineered太多东西，cost them。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "资源推荐："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "让自己被journey ahead of you的人surround，无论是通过masterminds、events还是social media。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们的insights能save you from common pitfalls，inspire bigger thinking。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他主要通过Dynamite Circle（DC）community获得这些。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "书推荐《Traction》。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Podcast推荐《Startups For The Rest of Us》。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "值得 revisit things。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "有时候你只是not ready for学到的东西。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他最近发现2017年conference的notebook，quick read给了2-3个ideas，那时候没ready。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "回头看goals很有趣。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他original end goal是50万美元ARR。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "某个时刻变成100万美元。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "达到时total non-event。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "可能截了图发给合伙人，然后继续过一天。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "你想象那一刻很exciting，但goals might change before you even get there。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "下一个milestone想hit 500万美元ARR。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "要达到，得组合new pricing、small sales team、expand产品到几个new use cases。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "确定会有很多challenges——尤其around hiring和finding能unlock that level of growth的channels。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "

content_en:
Stuck at $300K ARR, Until Pivoting to an Unexpected Industry


> Author: James Rose

> Tags: B2B Marketing, SaaS, SEO, Time Management


Have you ever worked for someone who didn't care?

James had.

And he was done.

---

His career started as a control systems engineer—fancy name for writing code to automate machines.

But he got tired of working for people who didn't care.

He and his partner just wanted out.

Wanted to build something of their own.

---

In 2010, they launched their first business—niche SEO software, sold around 2022.

From there, he co-founded a digital agency, specializing in website and software development.

This exposed them to many problems, begging for software solutions.

---

In 2014, they built a product that imported Stripe transactions into Xero (long before Xero offered this feature).

Sold in 2017.

Then built their latest venture—Content Snare, now at $1M ARR.

---

While doing agency work, they knew they didn't want to do client work forever, so they kept looking for new product ideas.

At some point, he read advice: Talk to potential customers without selling anything.

---

So they started calling agencies, asking about their biggest challenges.

One common pain point: getting content from clients.

Everyone hated chasing clients for content.

That's how Content Snare was born.

---

Key insight: Talk to customers, find real pain points.
content_jp:
30万美元ARRに停滞%、意外な業界にピボットして突破


> 著者：James Rose

> タグ：B2Bマーケティング、SaaS、SEO、タイムマネジメント


気の合わない人のために働いたことがある？

Jamesにはあった。

もう厌倦した。

---

彼のキャリアはコントロールシステムエンジニアから始まった—機械を自動化するためのコードを書く fancy name。

でも、氣にならない人のために働くのに厌倦した。

彼とパートナーは只想退出。

自分のものを構築したかった。

---

2010年%、最初のビジネスをローンチ—SEOニッチソフトウェア%、2022年頃に売却。

そこから%、彼はデジタル代理店を共同設立%、ウェブサイトとソフトウェア開発を専門とする。

これは多くの问题给他们了%、ソフトウェアソリューションを懇願していた。

---

2014年%、StripeトランザクションをXeroにインポートする製品を構築%（Xeroがこの机能提供するずっと前）。

2017年に売却。

そして、最新のベンチャーを構築—Content Snare、今100万美元ARR。

---

代理店の仕事をしている间%、永遠にクライアントワークをしたくないと思っていたので%、常に新しいプロダクトアイデアを探していた。

ある時点で%、彼はアドバイスを読んだ：何も売らずに潜在クライアントと話せ。

---

それで彼らは代理店に電話をかけ始めた%、最大の挑战について尋ねた。

1つの共通の痛苦点：クライアントからコンテンツを取得すること。

皆がクライアントのコンテンツを追いかけるのが嫌だった。

これがContent Snareの始まり。

---

重要な洞察：クライアントと話せ%、実際の痛苦点を見つけろ。
content_ar:
عالق عند 300 ألف دولار من الإيرادات السنوية المتكررة، حتى التحول إلى صناعة غير متوقعة


> المؤلف: جيمس روز

> الكلمات المفتاحية: تسويق B2B، البرمجيات كخدمة، محركات البحث، إدارة الوقت


هل عملت يوماً لشخص لا يهتم؟

جيمس فعل.

وقد اكتفي.

---

بدأ مساره كمهندس أنظمة تحكم—اسم متطور لكتابة كود لأتمتة الآلات.

لكنه تعب من العمل لأشخاص لا يهتمون.

هو وشريكه أرادا فقط الخروج.

أرادا بناء شيء خاص بهما.

---

في 2010، أطلقا أول عملهما—برمجية SEO متخصصة، بيعت حوالي 2022.

من هناك، شارك في تأسيس وكالة رقمية، متخصصة في تطوير المواقع والبرمجيات.

هذا كشفهما للكثير من المشاكل، تتوسل حلول برمجية.

---

في 2014، بنيا منتجاً يستورد معاملات Stripe إلى Xero (طويل قبل أن يوفر Xero هذه الميزة).

بيعا في 2017.

ثم بنيا أحدث مشروع لهما—Content Snare، الآن عند مليون دولار من الإيرادات السنوية المتكررة.

---

أثناء عملهما في الوكالة، علما أنهما لا يريدان عمل العميل للأبد، لذا استمرا في البحث عن أفكار منتجات جديدة.

في مرحلة ما، قرأ نصيحة: تحدث مع العملاء المحتملين دون بيع أي شيء.

---

لذلك بدأوا الاتصال بالوكالات، يسألون عن أكبر تحدياتها.

 نقطة ألم مشتركة واحدة: الحصول على المحتوى من العملاء.

الجميع يكره ملاحقة العملاء للحصول على المحتوى.

هكذا وُلد Content Snare.

---

رؤية رئيسية: تحدث مع العملاء، اعثر على نقاط الألم الحقيقية.
